$comment: HomeView's options, kept in one place. scripts/gen-docs.mjs writes README.md's option tables,
custom_pages/README.md's page-file tables and examples/full.yaml from this file, and
test/schema.test.mjs checks it against dist/homeview.js (KNOWN_OPTIONS, the editor, the keys the code
reads). Edit it here, then run scripts/gen-docs.sh. Row fields: name, type (tokens below), values,
default (a fixed value) or auto (what HomeView does by itself, in words), since (a version, or
unreleased), description (Markdown, without the default), example (a JSON value for full.yaml), alt
(other forms, shown as comments), keys (an object's keys), entry (a map's entries: rooms.<area>), item
(a list's items; ref = one of defs), editor (in the settings editor), for (tile types), alias_of (an old
or second name: accepted, not shown), internal (written by HomeView), todo (expected from a branch
that isn't merged yet: not shown; the test fails once the code reads it, so the row gets filled).
Type tokens: string number boolean entity area page color size time icon action any object map
list, a list of x as x[], literals true / false / null and the values listed in values.

groups.title: Screens: full screen, start page, screensaver, night

options.name: type
options.description: The dashboard strategy. The only line you need; every other option is optional. (`custom:homeview-dev`: a development copy made by `scripts/dev-build.sh`.)

options.name: title
options.description: The Home page's title and the dashboard's name.

options.name: theme
options.description: Light or dark; `auto` follows Home Assistant on each screen. Home Assistant's cards on HomeView's pages take HomeView's look too: light, dark or the night face.

options.name: pages
options.description: Which pages, in this order (also the swipe order). `rooms` = a page per family member's room (with no member rooms, the all-rooms directory). Also `all_rooms`, `people` and your own pages' paths. Old names still work: `family` = `living`, `members` = `rooms`. A page with nothing to show is left out.

options.name: pages_config
options.description: Per page: a page id (`home`, `living` …), a person page's path (`member-zoe`) or your own page's path.

keys.name: title
keys.description: The page's title and its name in the page bar (✎ in edit mode).

keys.name: icon
keys.description: The page's icon in the page bar.

keys.name: color
keys.description: The page's tint: a colour name (red, orange, amber, yellow, lime, green, teal, cyan, blue, indigo, purple, pink, brown, grey …) or a hue 0–360.

keys.name: sections
keys.description: Your own sections on this page (see [Your own tiles, cards and pages](#your-own-tiles-cards-and-pages)).

keys.name: hold
keys.description: Hold the page's title to open this page (a path), e.g. `admin`.

keys.name: popup
keys.description: A built-in page as a pop-up: not in the page bar or the swipe order, opened from its pill (Energy); ✕ goes back.

options.name: font
options.description: The whole dashboard in a font of your own, served by your Home Assistant: `geist` or `inter` (put the font file in place, see [Fonts](#fonts)), a font the screens already have (`Georgia`), or `{ family, url, weight }`. The clock keeps the system font.

keys.name: family
keys.description: The font's name.

keys.name: url
keys.description: Where to load it from, e.g. `/local/fonts/myfont.woff2`.

keys.name: weight
keys.description: The weights the file has.

options.name: room_order
options.description: These rooms (area ids) first, in this order; the rest after.

options.name: living_rooms
options.auto: the shared indoor rooms (not bedrooms, bathrooms, outdoor rooms or a family member's room), living spaces first
options.description: The rooms on the Living page, in this order.

options.name: hide_rooms
options.description: Rooms (areas) to leave out everywhere.

options.name: rooms
options.description: Per room, by its area id.

keys.name: name
keys.description: The room's name everywhere (✎ in edit mode).

keys.name: icon
keys.auto: the area's icon, else one that fits its name
keys.description: The room's icon.

keys.name: color
keys.auto: one of ten tints, in turn
keys.description: The room's tint: a colour name or a hue 0–360 (🎨 in edit mode); a person's page takes their room's colour.

keys.name: temperature
keys.auto: the area's own setting, else its first temperature sensor
keys.description: The room's temperature sensor.

keys.name: humidity
keys.auto: the area's own setting, else its first humidity sensor
keys.description: The room's humidity sensor.

keys.name: entities
keys.description: Show these first, in this order: on Living, a person's page and the room's page. Edit mode's + Add, ⊖ and dragging save it here.

keys.name: hidden
keys.description: Leave the room out, like `hide_rooms`.

keys.name: sections
keys.description: Your own sections on the room's page.

options.name: exclude_entities
options.description: Never show these anywhere (👁 in edit mode does the same): entity ids, globs (`sensor.*_linkquality`; `*` any text, `?` one character) or filters (`{ label: not_on_dashboard }`, `{ integration: zha, domain: sensor }`; every key: [custom_pages/README.md](custom_pages/README.md#an-entity-filter-exclude_entities-match)). Hidden, disabled, configuration and diagnostic entities are left out anyway. The settings editor keeps the patterns as they are.

options.name: customize
options.description: Per entity, wherever its tile appears.

keys.name: name
keys.description: The tile's name (✎ in edit mode).

keys.name: icon
keys.description: The tile's icon (◇ in edit mode).

keys.name: icon_on
keys.description: The icon while it's on (open, unlocked …).

keys.name: icon_off
keys.description: The icon while it's off.

keys.name: color_on
keys.description: The icon's colour while on: `green`, `amber`, `red`, `orange`, `blue` (the [colour code](#colours)) or any CSS colour.

keys.name: color_off
keys.description: The icon's colour while off.

keys.name: size
keys.description: `WxH` in grid cells: `1x1`, `2x1`, `2x2` … (⤢ in edit mode).

keys.name: tap
keys.description: `more-info`, `toggle`, `none`, or a page path to open.

keys.name: hold
keys.description: `more-info`, `toggle` (switch it on a hold), `none`, or a page path to open (the TV tile → a Media page). `tap: more-info` + `hold: toggle`: a stray tap can't switch it.

keys.name: hidden
keys.description: Hide it everywhere (👁 in edit mode).

keys.name: confirm
keys.description: Ask first wherever this entity can be switched (its tiles on every page, the pills' pop-ups, a chip, a button that toggles it): `true`, `turn_on` / `turn_off` (only before that: a lock's unlocking, a cover's opening), your question, or `{ text, only, action }`. A tile's or chip's own `confirm:` wins; locks and garage doors always ask, `confirm:` gives them your words.

options.name: people
options.auto: everyone with a phone or tracker
options.description: The people HomeView shows (avatars, who's home).

options.name: calendars
options.description: The calendars for Next, Up next and the agenda.

options.name: weather
options.description: The weather entity.

options.name: cameras
options.description: The cameras on the Cameras page.

options.name: access
options.auto: admins every page; everyone else the shared pages and only their own person page
options.description: Who sees which pages: a person entity or a login name → `all` (every page, every person page) or a list of pages (`rooms` = their own person page, `all_members` = every person page). Pages someone may not see aren't built for them; it hides, it doesn't secure.

options.name: members
options.auto: everyone whose first name is in a room's name (Bedroom Zoe, Alex's room), alphabetically
options.description: Person pages, in this order; `false` = none. By hand: `{ person.zoe: { area, calendars, name } }`.

keys.name: area
keys.description: The person's room.

keys.name: calendars
keys.auto: calendars with the person's name in them
keys.description: Their calendars, for their next event.

keys.name: name
keys.description: The name their page goes by.

keys.name: person
keys.description: The person (in a list of objects).

keys.name: area
keys.description: The person's room.

keys.name: calendars
keys.description: Their calendars.

keys.name: name
keys.description: The name their page goes by.

options.name: people_chips
options.description: The people's avatars under the Home title.

options.name: phone_favorites
options.auto: the main rooms' lights, then the locks (six at most)
options.description: The favourites strip on phones (Living, a person's page): one list, or one per login name with `default` for everyone else.

entry.name: <login>
entry.description: That login's favourites; `default`: everyone without a list.

options.name: avatars
options.description: People without a picture: `samples` (anime-style avatars from DiceBear, the same one each time; no names are sent) or `initials` (no internet request). Per person: `man`, `woman`, `boy`, `girl` or a picture's URL. A picture set on the person in Home Assistant always wins.

options.name: guest
options.description: The guest view (see [Guest view](#guest-view)): while the entity is on, shared screens leave out the person pages, People, Cameras and admin-only pages (out of the swipe order, the page dots and the page bar), the people on Home and every camera, person and calendar tile; Widgets drops the agenda and shows the sample photos. A "Guest" label by the title says why. Every screen but admins', unless `screens` names them. It hides, it doesn't secure.

keys.name: entity
keys.description: The helper that turns it on (on = guests are here). Without one, the `screens` listed always show the guest view.

keys.name: screens
keys.description: Only these logins: a person entity or a login's name (admins too, when listed).

keys.name: hide
keys.description: More pages to hide (person pages, People, Cameras and admin-only pages always are).

keys.name: slideshow
keys.description: The photos on Widgets in the guest view: a media folder, `samples`, or `false` for none.

options.name: widgets
options.description: The Widgets page.

keys.name: slideshow
keys.auto: the first media folder named Photos, Pictures, Slideshow …, else sample photos (from picsum.photos)
keys.description: The photo folder (`media-source://…`), `samples`, or `false` for none.

keys.name: slideshow_interval
keys.description: Seconds per photo.

keys.name: slideshow_thumbnail
keys.description: A smaller copy to try first, e.g. `{dir}/.@__thumb/s800{name}` on a QNAP NAS; falls back to the full photo.

keys.name: camera
keys.description: A camera here instead of the photos (the camera is on Home).

keys.name: font
keys.description: The Widgets page alone in a font of your own (see `font`).

options.name: home
options.description: The Home page.

keys.name: favorites
keys.auto: two that HomeView picks, doors first (locks, garage)
keys.description: Tiles near the top of Home; `[]` = none. In edit mode ★ adds or removes one and a drag moves it.

keys.name: max_favorites
keys.description: How many favourites HomeView picks by itself.

keys.name: light_rooms
keys.auto: the two main rooms with lights
keys.description: Rooms with a Lights tile on Home (tap = all on / off, hold = the room).

keys.name: max_light_rooms
keys.description: How many Lights tiles HomeView picks by itself.

keys.name: chips
keys.auto: the alarm, garage doors and gates, locks and a water shut-off valve
keys.description: Round control chips under the title: an entity, or an object with the keys below; `'|'` between two starts a new group (a gap before the next chip); `false` = none. Drag them in edit mode to reorder.

keys.name: entity
keys.description: The entity.

keys.name: name
keys.description: Its name (in the confirm sheet).

keys.name: icon_on
keys.description: The icon while on.

keys.name: icon_off
keys.description: The icon while off.

keys.name: color
keys.description: A switch's colour while on: `security` (green), `light` (orange), `climate` (blue) or a CSS colour.

keys.name: confirm
keys.description: Ask first (locks, garage doors and the water valve always do): `true`, `turn_on` / `turn_off`, your question, or `{ text, only, action }` (see `customize.<entity>.confirm`).

keys.name: off_warn
keys.description: Amber while off (something that should stay on).

keys.name: tap
keys.description: `more-info`: open the details instead of switching.

keys.name: label
keys.description: A short word beside the icon on tablets and in a browser ("Auto lights"), so a mode switch says what it is; phones show the icon only. The chip's own word (Open, Offline …) takes its place while there is one.

keys.name: camera
keys.description: The camera on Home; `false` = none.

keys.name: air
keys.description: The air-quality tile, when there's an AQI, PM2.5, CO₂ or VOC sensor.

keys.name: rooms
keys.description: Room tiles on Home (they're on Living and each room's page).

keys.name: scenes
keys.description: The scenes on Home.

keys.name: max_scenes
keys.description: The most scenes on Home.

options.name: pills
options.description: The status pills on Home, in this order: `alarm`, `climate`, `energy`, `lights`, `locks`, `openings`, `safety`, `batteries`, `media`, `warnings`, or an object with the keys below; `false` = none. Drag them in edit mode to reorder.

keys.name: pill
keys.description: A built-in pill with a `hold:` (or `tap:`) of its own: `{ pill: energy, hold: energy-history }`.

keys.name: entity
keys.description: A pill of your own: this entity's state.

keys.name: name
keys.description: Its name, before the state; `''` = the state alone.

keys.name: icon
keys.description: Its icon.

keys.name: alert
keys.description: States that turn it red.

keys.name: unit
keys.description: A power sensor's value in this unit.

keys.name: format
keys.description: Show a time in this format (an `input_datetime`, a date / time entity, a timestamp sensor, or the `attribute` that holds one): "in 2 hours", "2 h 5 min" … (see the tile key `format`).

keys.name: attribute
keys.description: Show this attribute instead of the state (`last_changed`: when the state last changed).

keys.name: show_when
keys.description: Show the pill only while this condition holds (see the tile key `show_when`).

keys.name: tap
keys.description: A page path to open on a tap.

keys.name: hold
keys.description: A page path to open on a hold.

keys.name: page_pill
keys.description: Where your own page's pill (`pill:` in its file) goes in the order; its look comes from the page file.

options.name: warnings
options.description: A Warnings pill, first on Home, only while one of these rules is true; tap = a pop-up with each warning's entities. In edit mode tap the pill to add or remove warnings.

options.name: battery_low
options.description: A battery under this % counts as low (the Batteries pill).

options.name: comfort
options.description: When a room is Comfy (Too cold · Cold · Comfy · Warm · Hot on room tiles). `thermostat`: the room's thermostat (its own, else the house's), from its heat setting − margin to its cool setting + margin, so a cooler night setting reads Comfy at night. `fixed`: 66–77 °F (19–25 °C). Or `{ cold, warm }`.

keys.name: cold
keys.description: Cold below this (a number or an entity whose state is one).

keys.name: warm
keys.description: Warm above this.

options.name: comfort_thermostat
options.auto: the first thermostat with a setting
options.description: The house's thermostat, for rooms without their own.

options.name: comfort_margin
options.description: How far either side of the thermostat's settings still counts as Comfy (a number or an entity).

options.name: comfort_limits
options.description: The outer grades: numbers or entities (`input_number` helpers). A room is Comfy only when its temperature and humidity both are.

keys.name: too_cold
keys.description: Too cold below this; never closer than 3 °F (1.5 °C) to Comfy.

keys.name: hot
keys.description: Hot above this; Cold and Warm come from `comfort`.

keys.name: too_dry
keys.description: Humidity %: Too dry below this.

keys.name: dry
keys.description: Dry below this.

keys.name: humid
keys.description: Humid above this.

keys.name: too_humid
keys.description: Too humid above this.

options.name: energy
options.description: The Energy page and live power, when Home Assistant's Energy settings don't say. Otherwise HomeView finds the sensors itself: a net sensor on the meter's own device first, a split pair if that's all there is, never an average.

keys.name: windows
keys.description: Off-grid share in time windows (peak hours …), from hourly statistics: `{ name, start, end, days }`, or `hours:` with several spans, each with its own days.

keys.name: name
keys.description: The window's name.

keys.name: end
keys.description: Until (`'24:00'` = midnight).

keys.name: days
keys.description: `weekdays`, `weekends`, `daily`, or days (`mon`, `tue` … or 0–6).

keys.name: hours
keys.description: Several spans instead of `start` / `end`, each with its own `days`.

keys.name: start
keys.description: From.

keys.name: end
keys.description: Until.

keys.name: days
keys.description: The days of this span.

keys.name: battery_energy
keys.description: kWh left in the battery.

keys.name: battery_capacity
keys.description: The battery's size in kWh, when there's no energy-left sensor (× the battery level).

keys.name: grid_status
keys.auto: a sensor named like grid status
keys.description: The grid's state, for the outage list. With unusual states: `{ entity, up: [states] }` (anything else is down) or `{ entity, down: [states] }`. Unknown or unavailable reads "grid status unknown", never "grid on".

keys.name: entity
keys.description: The grid-status entity.

keys.name: up
keys.description: Its states that mean the grid is up.

keys.name: down
keys.description: Its states that mean the grid is down.

keys.name: outage
keys.description: The power-outage list (see [Power outages](#power-outages)); `false` = the devices only.

keys.name: label
keys.description: The Home Assistant label that holds the ticks (a name or an id).

keys.name: on_label
keys.description: A second tick: turn on in an outage.

keys.name: off_action
keys.description: **Turn off ticked** runs this instead of `homeassistant.turn_off`: a script gets `entities` (the ticked switches) and `on_entities`; or `{ action, data, target }`.

keys.name: on_action
keys.description: **Turn back on** runs this instead of `homeassistant.turn_on`.

keys.name: switches
keys.description: A device's switch by hand: `{ <energy sensor>: <switch> }`.

keys.name: home_current
keys.auto: on the home power sensor's device
keys.description: The current for the "A at V" line.

keys.name: voltage
keys.auto: on the home power sensor's device
keys.description: The voltage for the "A at V" line.

keys.name: flow_card
keys.description: `auto` = Power Flow Card Plus when it's installed (HACS), else HomeView's own; `homeview` = always HomeView's own.

keys.name: flow_devices
keys.description: Devices shown as their own circles in Power Flow Card Plus.

keys.name: flow_card_options
keys.description: Anything else for Power Flow Card Plus.

keys.name: solar_power
keys.auto: the Energy settings' power sensor, else one named like it
keys.description: Solar power now.

keys.name: grid_power
keys.auto: the Energy settings' power sensor, else a net sensor named like it
keys.description: Grid power now: + import, − export (a net sensor).

keys.name: grid_import_power
keys.description: Without a net sensor: a split pair, both positive (import).

alt.note: with grid_export_power: a split pair, both positive

keys.name: grid_export_power
keys.description: The split pair's export side.

keys.name: battery_power
keys.auto: the Energy settings' power sensor, else a net sensor named like it
keys.description: Battery power now: + discharge, − charge (a net sensor).

keys.name: battery_discharge_power
keys.description: Without a net sensor: a split pair, both positive (discharge).

keys.name: battery_charge_power
keys.description: The split pair's charge side.

keys.name: battery_level
keys.auto: the % sensor on the battery's device, or named like it
keys.description: The home battery's charge %.

keys.name: home_power
keys.description: The home's power now.

keys.name: devices
keys.description: How many devices under "Devices today".

keys.name: mode_entities
keys.todo: possible (architect F9: battery mode / reserve as pills on the Energy page): only if a branch adds it

options.name: kiosk
options.description: Full screen: hide Home Assistant's header and sidebar. The Menu chip shows them until the page reloads; `?kiosk=off` in the address too.

options.name: kiosk_chip
options.description: The Menu / Full screen chip. Turn it off on a wall tablet so nobody leaves full screen by accident.

options.name: page_dots
options.description: Page dots at the bottom in full screen: where you are, and a tap goes to another page.

options.name: start
options.auto: phones open on Home, tablets and browsers on the first page
options.description: The page a session opens on (a link to a page is kept): one page for every screen, or `{ phone, tablet }`.

keys.name: phone
keys.description: Phones (narrower than 600 px).

keys.name: tablet
keys.description: Tablets and browsers.

options.name: desktop_layout
options.description: A desktop browser window (no touch screen, at least 1000 px wide) lays out like a landscape tablet even when it's taller than wide; `fill` = the whole window height. Touch screens aren't changed.

options.name: screensaver
options.description: A big clock after 2 minutes without a touch: `auto` = touch tablets only, `true` = every screen, `false` = never, or the keys below.

keys.name: idle
keys.description: Seconds without a touch (at least 10).

keys.name: color
keys.description: The clock's colour.

keys.name: pages
keys.description: Only on these pages.

keys.name: enabled
keys.description: `false` = off.

options.name: night
options.description: The night face (see [Night](#night)): an entity (night while it's on), `auto` (the sun is down and it's 9 pm or later, until morning), or `{ from, to }` every day.

keys.name: from
keys.description: Night from (`'21:30'`).

options.name: custom_pages
options.description: Pages of your own, usually one file each: `custom_pages: !include_dir_list custom_pages`. Every key of a page, a section and a tile is in [custom_pages/README.md](custom_pages/README.md#every-key).

options.name: tile_size
options.auto: the tile formula: columns 110–300 px wide, 4 rows on a screen
options.description: Instead of the standard grid: as many columns as fit tiles at least this wide (px).

options.name: max_columns
options.description: Never more columns than this.

options.name: rows_on_screen
options.description: Rows a page fits on one tablet or browser screen (tiles stay between square and 1.35 : 1): one number, or `{ <page>: n }`; `0` = square tiles. Energy keeps its own rows.

options.name: swipe
options.description: Swipe between pages. HomeView turns the swipe-navigation plugin off on this dashboard, so one swipe is one page; `false` = leave swiping to it.

options.name: edit_button
options.description: Double-tap a page title for edit mode (admins only).

options.name: update_notice
options.description: An update icon for admins when HACS has a newer HomeView.

options.name: ui_edits
options.description: On a YAML dashboard, keep what you change on screen in a hidden companion dashboard, `<dashboard>-edits`; `false` = show the YAML to paste instead.

options.name: from
options.description: Mirror another HomeView dashboard (its address): its settings, pages and on-screen edits, read each time it loads. The mirror's own changes are kept in `edits:` and never touch the original.

alt.note: on a second dashboard: the first one's address

options.name: edits
options.description: Written by HomeView on a `from:` mirror: its own changes, laid over the source's settings. Not for editing by hand.

keys.name: path
keys.description: The page's address, `/<dashboard>/<path>`, and the word a `hold:` or `tap:` names. Keep it the file's name.

keys.name: title
keys.description: The big title at the top.

keys.name: icon
keys.description: The icon in the page bar.

keys.name: color
keys.description: The page's tint: a colour name or a hue 0–360.

keys.name: subview
keys.description: Not in the page bar or the swipe order: opened by a hold (or tap) that names it, with a ✕ that goes back.

keys.name: admin_only
keys.description: Only for viewers who see every page: admins (unless `access` gives them a list) and logins with `access: all`.

keys.name: pills
keys.description: The status pills at the top, as on Home.

keys.name: pill
keys.description: A pill on Home, for everyone who gets the page: tap = this page, hold = the entity's details. `true` = the page's title and icon.

keys.name: entity
keys.description: The entity whose state it shows.

keys.name: name
keys.description: Its name; `''` = the state alone.

keys.name: icon
keys.description: Its icon.

keys.name: alert
keys.description: States that turn it red.

keys.name: unit
keys.description: A power sensor's value in this unit.

keys.name: format
keys.description: A time in this format (see the tile key `format`).

keys.name: attribute
keys.description: Show this attribute instead of the state.

keys.name: show_when
keys.description: Show the pill only while this condition holds.

keys.name: hold
keys.description: Hold this page's title to open another page.

keys.name: columns
keys.description: Columns on tablets and browsers.

keys.name: show_room
keys.description: `false` = tiles show their state, not their room.

keys.name: alerts
keys.description: A banner while a rule is true (the rules of `warnings:`); the page's pill on Home warns too.

keys.name: vars

entry.name: <name>
entry.description: Its value: an entity, a list, any text.

keys.description: The entities the page uses: `$name` anywhere below becomes its value; a list stays a list and is spread inside a `tiles:` list.

keys.name: sections
keys.description: The page's sections.

keys.name: title
keys.description: A heading; leave it out for none.

keys.name: position
keys.description: On a built-in page or a room's page: `top` = above HomeView's own tiles.

keys.name: color
keys.description: The section's own tint.

keys.name: icon
keys.description: An icon before the title.

keys.name: layout
keys.description: `pills`: small pills in a row (sensors with their value); `keypad`: icon buttons in a grid (a remote); `faders`: sliders, two per row on tablets; `rows`: a list.

keys.name: width
keys.description: `half`: two sections side by side on tablets (stacked on phones).

keys.name: columns
keys.description: A keypad's columns.

keys.name: icons_only
keys.description: Pills without their names (a keypad always is).

keys.name: tiles
keys.description: The tiles: an entity id, a glob (`light.kids_room_*`: one tile per entity, by name), `{ … }` (the keys below; `match:` for a filter), or `.` for an empty key in a keypad.

keys.name: show_when
keys.description: Show the section only while this condition holds (keys: [A condition](#a-condition-show_when)). A section whose tiles are all hidden hides too.

keys.name: defaults
keys.description: Tile keys every tile of the section gets (a tile's own keys win), e.g. a remote's `{ type: button, action: remote.send_command, target: remote.tv }` once.

keys.name: entity
keys.for: entity, camera, person, chart, fader, weather, forecast
keys.description: The entity (a tile that's only an entity can be written as its id).

keys.name: type
keys.description: The tile's kind. An unknown type is left out with a note for admins.

keys.name: card
keys.description: Any Lovelace card's config, HACS cards included: `{ card: { type: thermostat, entity: climate.hallway } }`.

keys.name: area
keys.description: The room's area id.

keys.name: size
keys.description: `WxH` in grid cells (`2x1`, `4x2` …), or `full` / `half` the page's width with a height (`full x 3`); a height of `auto` fits a card's content. It shrinks on narrow screens.

keys.name: phone_size
keys.description: The size on phones (2 columns, 64 px rows), e.g. `2x5`.

keys.name: name
keys.description: Its name.

keys.name: icon
keys.for: entity, button, fader, chart, agenda, next_event
keys.description: Its icon.

keys.name: icon_on
keys.description: The icon while on.

keys.name: icon_off
keys.description: The icon while off (a button: while it isn't lit).

keys.name: color_on
keys.description: The icon's colour while on (the colour code or CSS).

keys.name: color_off
keys.description: The icon's colour while off.

keys.name: color
keys.description: Its colour while lit (a chart: its line).

keys.name: name_off
keys.description: Its name while it isn't on.

keys.name: tap
keys.description: `more-info`, `toggle`, `none`, or a page path.

keys.name: hold
keys.description: `more-info`, `toggle` (switch it on a hold), `none`, a page path, or (a button) `{ action, data, target }`. `tap: more-info` + `hold: toggle`: a stray tap can't switch it.

keys.name: show_room
keys.description: `false` = its state instead of its room, where tiles show rooms.

keys.name: power
keys.description: A power sensor: "On · 0.72 kW" while it draws.

keys.name: confirm
keys.description: Ask first, in HomeView's own sheet: `true`, `turn_on` / `turn_off` (only before that), your question, or `{ text, only, action }`. It guards the gesture that switches (the tap, or the hold with `hold: toggle`).

keys.name: unit
keys.description: A power sensor's value in this unit.

keys.name: more
keys.description: A "Show all" button on the card that switches it to these settings (`null` removes one) and back.

keys.name: more_label
keys.description: The button's words; `{energy_devices}` = how many devices your Energy settings track.

keys.name: less_label
keys.description: The words to switch back.

keys.name: legend_more
keys.description: `false` hides a chart's own "More (n)" legend chip.

keys.name: calendars
keys.description: Its calendars.

keys.name: days
keys.description: Days ahead.

keys.name: max
keys.description: The most events.

keys.name: match
keys.description: An entity tile: a glob or a filter (keys: [An entity filter](#an-entity-filter-exclude_entities-match)), one tile per entity with the other keys; `state:` in the filter shows each only while it's in that state. Agenda and next event: only events whose title matches (a regular expression, any case), e.g. `'no school|break'`.

keys.name: all_day
keys.description: Only all-day events.

keys.name: strip
keys.description: Text removed from the titles.

keys.name: join_weekends
keys.description: Adds the weekend right before or after a day off and joins breaks that then touch.

keys.name: layout
keys.description: `list`: one row per event with its dates and length.

keys.name: weekday_word
keys.description: The word in the list's total: "3 school days off".

keys.name: long_icon
keys.description: The icon of a break longer than a day.

keys.name: event_icon
keys.description: The icon of a one-day event.

keys.name: title
keys.description: Its heading.

keys.name: decimals
keys.description: Decimals of the value.

keys.name: stale_minutes
keys.description: Minutes after which a reading counts as old.

keys.name: battery
keys.description: The battery shown with the person.

keys.name: action
keys.description: What a tap runs: a script or any action (`script.tv_source`, `light.turn_on` …).

keys.name: data
keys.description: The action's data.

keys.name: target
keys.description: The action's target: an entity id, a list of them, or `{ entity_id, area_id … }`.

keys.name: toggle
keys.description: Instead of `action`: toggle this entity; lit while it's on.

keys.name: watch
keys.description: Lit while this entity's state (or `attribute`) is `when`.

keys.name: when
keys.description: The state (or a list of states) that lights it.

keys.name: attribute
keys.description: An entity tile shows this attribute instead of the state (`battery_level`; `last_changed`: when it last changed); a button watches it instead of the state (a TV's `source`).

keys.name: format
keys.description: Show a time (an `input_datetime`, a date / time entity, a timestamp sensor, or the `attribute` that holds one) as `time` "6:30 AM", `date` "Thu, Nov 13", `datetime`, `relative` "in 2 hours", `until` "2 h 5 min" or `since` "3 h 20 min" (the last three redraw every 30 s).

keys.name: dim
keys.description: A lit button shows as an outline while this entity is off.

keys.name: mute
keys.description: An `input_boolean` that mutes it (tap the icon); muted faders are grey with MUTED.

keys.name: show_when
keys.description: Show the tile only while this condition holds, live: an entity (while it's on), `{ entity, state / state_not }`, `{ entity, above / below }`, `{ user: [...] }`, `{ admin: true }`, `and:` / `or:` / `not:` (a list = all of them), or Home Assistant's own `condition:` shapes (keys: [A condition](#a-condition-show_when)). Edit mode shows the hidden ones faded.

keys.name: entity
keys.description: The entity it reads. Alone: while it's on (a lock: unlocked, a cover: open, a person: home, media: playing).

keys.name: attribute
keys.description: Read this attribute instead of the state (alone: while it's set).

keys.name: state
keys.description: Its state is one of these.

keys.name: state_not
keys.description: Its state is none of these.

keys.name: above
keys.description: Its value is above this (a number or an entity's value).

keys.name: below
keys.description: Its value is below this.

keys.name: user
keys.description: Who's looking: a login name (or its first word), a user id or a person entity linked to the login.

keys.name: users
keys.description: The same as `user` (Home Assistant's `condition: user` writes it this way).

keys.name: admin
keys.description: `true`: admins only; `false`: everyone else.

keys.name: and
keys.description: All of these conditions.

keys.name: or
keys.description: Any of these conditions.

keys.name: not
keys.description: None of these conditions.

keys.name: condition
keys.description: Home Assistant's own visibility shape, with its keys (`entity`, `state`, `above`, `users`, `conditions`, `media_query`).

keys.name: conditions
keys.description: The conditions of Home Assistant's `and` / `or` / `not`.

keys.name: media_query
keys.description: `condition: screen`: a CSS media query, e.g. `'(min-width: 600px)'`.

keys.name: entity_id
keys.description: Ids or globs (`light.kids_room_*`). Diagnostic entities match only when named this way (or with `diagnostic: true`).

keys.name: domain
keys.description: Domains: `light`, `sensor` …

keys.name: area
keys.description: Areas, by id or name.

keys.name: label
keys.description: Labels, by id or name (a label on the device counts).

keys.name: device_class
keys.description: Device classes: `door`, `battery` …

keys.name: integration
keys.description: Integrations: `zha`, `mqtt` …

keys.name: not
keys.description: But not these (ids, globs or filters).

keys.name: diagnostic
keys.description: Match diagnostic and settings entities too.

keys.name: state
keys.description: A tile's `match:` only: each tile shows only while its entity is in one of these states (live).

keys.name: state_not
keys.description: A tile's `match:` only: each tile shows only while its entity is in none of these states.

keys.name: text
keys.description: The question.

keys.name: only
keys.description: Ask only before switching it on (a lock: unlocking, a cover: opening) or off.

keys.name: action
keys.description: The button's word, e.g. `Sound`.

alert.title: A warning or alert rule (warnings:, a page's alerts:)

keys.name: text
keys.description: What it says.

keys.name: level
keys.description: `critical` = red, `notice` = amber.

keys.name: not_on
keys.description: Rule: true while it isn't on (off, offline or missing).

keys.name: on
keys.description: Rule: true while every one is on.

keys.name: off
keys.description: Rule: true while every one is off.

keys.name: all_off
keys.description: Rule: true while all of them are off.

keys.name: none_on
keys.description: Rule: true while none is confirmed on (off, offline and missing all count), e.g. both pumps off.

keys.name: text_offline
keys.auto: "<name> not reporting", or "Can't check: <text>" for a missing entity
keys.description: What it says, in amber, while the rule can't be checked.

keys.name: entities
keys.description: What the Warnings pop-up lists.
